# Which allowed starting weapon carries a fresh Nightmare 1 game through 5:00

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | done |
| Area | build |
| Result | refuted |
| Created | L1.I9 |
| Updated | L1.I10 |

## Hypothesis

Fresh starts that evolve at the first chest (steam-vent, fry-sentry, seeker-sprouts, tot-toss) or fry-knives with strong luck pickups survive the Masher and elite wave at 5:00-6:00 on Nightmare 1, and one of them is the best weapon to start the full run with.

## Method

Five fresh Nightmare 1 games on seed 23 for 300 s with the playbook unchanged, each starting with a different weapon from the full-run unlock list. Compare health at 2:00, 5:00 and 5:59, chest count and first chest time, evolutions, damage by weapon and kills.

## Findings

The hypothesis that fresh steam-vent, fry-sentry, tot-toss or fry-knives would survive 5:00 on Nightmare 1 was refuted: only seeker-sprouts lived (1 of 5, 2800 kills). Fry-knives died at 2:46, steam-vent at 3:12, fry-sentry at 2:01 and tot-toss at 2:40 with 0-2 chests. The playbook rehearsal that followed gave the same ratio (1 of 5), again with seeker-sprouts as the survivor.
